Bronkhorstspruit wrestling photographer: Photography or Paedophilia?

By: Sasha OLD | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Pictures of children as young as 8 in suggestive photos supposedly illustrating fighting positions being sold online. Is Neville Randall naive, or is he profiting from child pornography?

Unique Selling Point:
Despite the media reporting on this 3 months ago, we have found several fetish websites that feature his photos, and pornsites connected to where his photo's are posted. We also can prove that after taking everything down in November last year, on December 2, he opened a new website - youngwarriors.co.za which features the exact same content as before....We'd also speak to wrestling SA head coach Nico Coetzee, and take away Randall's defence...

In November 2019 Rapport newspaper reported on a man purporting to be a wrestling, karate coach in Bronkhorstspruit. He has been taking photo's of children since the early 2000s, and for the past few years has beenn making videos as well, in positions he says are to illustrate wrestling or self defense. He sells them online off his website for roughly R1,500 a DVD (depending on the currency's around the world) http://www.fightingkids.com/dvdboyboylowblows.htm
But if you look at the pictures/videos a reasonable person may look at them and realize they seem sexually suggestive or imply BDSM characteristics.

So where are these children's parents? Well, they are give written consent to Randall to take the photo's and are paid roughly R800 for their children's participating. Some like Child Protection expert Luke Lamprecht believes the children's parents, who come from low economic backgrounds, are exploiting their children, and should be held responsible; But the parents say their children enjoy it and have fun doing it. The parents on facebook defended their actions say that Randall love fantasy, and for payment, children can be picked out of lineup and someone can choose who they want DVD's and videos of and what they want them to do...

So who would buy pictures, and video's of children, boys and girls, 'fighting'? Well further investigation shows that these pictures end up on sites that may be a hunting ground for pedophiles - like "BOYS FUN" - A website that clearly is a fetish website, with topics like 'tickling, fighting and boys tied up' are displayed. https://boysfunphotosets.weebly.com/boys-tied-up.html Lamprecht has observed some of the photo's, websites, video's etc and says these children are being exploited and used - he believes this is child pornography, grooming and child endangerment based on both the Children's Act, and Criminal (Sexual offences and related matters) Act. We will interview the Karate coach who has been ringing the bell on this for years, as well as sisters - Patricia and Jennifer who used to take photos/videos and now have realized what they were used for. Randall did an interview with Rapport - which they have given to us, and we will ask him for an interview, but we do have his answers already.

Summary:
Since the articles came out 3 months ago, nothing has happened, police have been stumped on how to proceed. FCS W/O Boshoff is investigating the case, and says he is having a problem proving this is child pornography, but also getting people to make statements. The NPA have a special unit called SOCA that could assist in helping him make the case and are currently doing that, although it's likely they will not be able to speak, I did alert them to the case. Lamprecht went through the acts and has found numerous places that could apply to this case with both the parents and Randall. (In futher below section). Child Educational Psychologist Dr Chris Uitzinger says these photo's may psychologically affect the children later - when they realize the nature of these photos. Dr Uitzinger will speak about Paraphilia (previously known as sexual perversion and sexual deviation), which is the experience of intense sexual arousal to atypical objects, situations, fantasies, behaviors, or individuals. He will speak about how these photos are part of a fantasy, and how paedophiles may use them to initiate themselves into the underground world of child pornography.

Children’s Wrestling Pics: Sports Photography or Child Porn?
On the face of it the photos seem to capture children having fun. For at least 20 years, a Mpumalanga-based photographer has paid children to demonstrate what he describes as wrestling grips – a part of his anti-bullying campaign. He’s filmed these fighting scenes, produced over 2000 DVDs and sold the images online. Now, Carte Blanche investigates how these images have popped up on adult fetish and pornographic websites.
Producer: Sasha Schwendenwein | Presenter: Derek Watts


Script:


It’s always been a small tight-knit community with friendly neighbours. But it’s inside this house, where some parents bring their Underage children to act out wrestling scenes for a so-called photographer...he then instructs the youngsters to pose for what he calls anti-bullying instruction videos ... but instead, come across as provocative photographs and children participating in sexually suggestive videos. They’re paid between 250 to 1,500 rand for their participation, then the visuals are posted to a website that can be seen by anyone with internet access. The content is disturbing and we’ve taken the decision to broadcast only a small selection of the least revealing of the thousands of visuals... to illustrate the serious nature of what some experts believe is sexually explicit material of children.
THE TOWN OF BRONKHORSTSPRUIT, 30 MINUTES FROM PRETORIA HAS BEEN SPLIT, OVER PICTURES AND VIDEOS OF CHILDREN POSING – ARE THEY LIKE SOME PARENTS AND THE PHOTOGRAPHER SAY BE HARMLESS FUN,OR ARE THEY SEXUALLY SUGGESTIVE AND CHILD PORNOGRAPHY?
The internet business Fightingkids.com is owned by self-proclaimed photographer Neville Randall. He took these photos of Jennifer Odendaal and “Susette,” who were only 8 when they began to pose for him.
Jen: I don't know if you can call it wrestling positions. But you have to sit on top of another guy or you have to squeeze him with your hands and you sit on top of him.
Susette: You have to push your legs half over his throat to choke him now or whatever and how the girl or guy's head is literally between your legs.
Randall’s videos or photos can be ordered or bought for between 1,000 to 1,500 rand. He in turn paid the kids for every photoshoot.
Jen: A good month was about 3000-4000 rand.
The site has a seemingly large international audience. Randall calls these clients, his “sponsors.” They can pick which children they want to star in their own photo shoot or movie which is then sent to them on DVD.
Susette: people called or email him and then asked me if and then for someone else with whom I should do it with. Then they said exactly what they want and I assume then there is a storyline or something told them exactly how everything should go and then you had to.
Randall has produced over 2000 DVDs, and we estimate that he could have paid out as much as R3-million to the children who participate. a figure he doesn’t dispute.
Susette: To be honest it scares me to know where my photos are and where my videos are.
When Jennifer and Susette turned 18, they were told they were too old to continue.
Derek: Looking at those pictures now, what do you think they reflect?
S: Soft porn to be honest I can’t understand why anyone wants these types of pictures.
Then November last year, the Afrikaans press reported that some images had ended up on pornographic websites, and some comments about the children raised red flags. This caused Randall to delete some material.
Susette: Here’s a photo, how on earth is that a Judo pose?
Then in mid-February this year, Carte Blanche used investigative techniques like reverse image searches to find these photos. Although they originated from Randall’s FIGHTING KIDS site, they appear on adult fetish websites, like “boys fun” where tickling, bare-feet and boys tied-up are shown. More videos appeared on social media websites of children acting out storylines, Randall says, these are part of an anti-bullying campaign.
UPSOUND: OUCH Just leave my hair please. (Tie up…)
COMBINED HIS BITES BELOW
We showed all the photographs and videos to educational Psychologist Chris Uitzinger for an assessment. He says the sexually suggestive poses may harm a child psychologically.
Chris: These children are being used as sexual currency they're being sexually exploited for financial gain. Imagine having sexually explicit pictures of yourself as a child out there and that's likely to cause you're likely to have quite profound effects on an individual's sexuality their identity and their general self worth.”

Chris: There are elements of sadism and masochism this involves inflicting suffering humiliation or bondage on another person or having that inflicted on you and that results in sexual arousal; the moment it involves children it becomes one paedophilia, and two sexual assault, because children do not have the legal capacity to consent.
Child protection expert Luke Lamprecht believes the photos are part of the sexual grooming process.
Luke: So you create this little club which is wrestling from there you go into what we call taboo, or boundary violation. So you go from things that in fact are normal, and what they steadily do is they blur that boundary.
BUT WHAT ROLE DO THE PARENTS PLAY IN ALL OF THIS? WE’VE BEEN TOLD THEY SIGN CONSENT FORMS, AND SOMETIMES ARE PRESENT DURING THE PHOTOSHOOTS, BUT DO THEY UNDERSTAND WHAT THEY ARE CONSENTING TO?
Anita: I trust Neville with my life.
“Anita” spoke on camera willingly, but we are hiding her identity to protect her two boys, the youngest of which is 15 and still poses for Randall.
Anita: I have no problem taking it there wasn't once he touched them that they were naked or showed anything of them that should not be shown.
Derek: When you look at some of these poses here, can you see why they are on a site called boys fun?
Anita: I can’t see what's wrong with the photos.
Derek: So even with pictures of your boys on an international site which is seemingly known for child pornography it wouldnt worry you?
Anita: Well if he is on such a site and they show him with all his clothes on I can not say it is pornography.
Luke: The fact that there’s contact through clothing, is still sexual violation, and they do not have to be naked. So these sexual acts are compelled sexual violation where somebody is compelling somebody, who is a child, to do something sexual to another child for erotic purposes of the adult.
Derek walking upto vehicle.
SoundUp: Derek, Derek Watts from Carte Blanche. We want to speak to you about your photographic business?
Randall: What kind of questions do you want to ask me?
We tracked down Randall at his house.
Derek: Neville every story I see calls you a wrestling coach?
Neville Randall: No I'm not a wrestling coach.I don’t know where the people get that from. This is like a film house. It's like acting. I have to show them what a certain technique is like. For instance a cradle. It's like a stunt director tells the person what to do to get a certain hold.
SA Wrestling Federation’s head coach Nico Coetzee looked at the pictures to ascertain if they depict wrestling accurately.
Nico: It doesn’t represent any position you’ll find in wrestling….
Coetzee demonstrates that wrestling is a dynamic quick-movement sport - not posing for photos.
Luke: Grooming in sport allows you to blur boundaries. They call it wrestling, but it is actually sexual exploitation.

And then you get some weird person that takes a normal picture away like a schoolboy pin where somebody is spinning somebody and then he says ugly stuff. The parents know about this stuff what we do. I am paying them for these services.
Neville says he doesn’t know who his sponsors are or how some pictures got onto fetish websites.
Derek: Why are they sponsoring pictures of kids fighting?
NR: Sometimes, people, it reminds them of the youth. So what they do is they like writing the story, they like to see the story being published in a movie format.
Derek: You're making money out of it and you're providing a platform for other websites that do feed Paedophilic tendencies. NR: The police that said they've made an investigation and they said we're not doing something wrong here.
Derek: But you must have thought why would so many people want to buy these DVDs or watch this online?
NR: I'm just I'm just I thought I was just very lucky.
Derek: You're paying children to act and to act out some quite unusual moves which I don't see how we can talk about them as proper wrestling moves. What we see doing here?
NR: so we did a story where one bully, bully the other bully and we're going to tie you up, I know that some people will find that a little bit disturbing
Derek: We're talking about bondage here.
NR: We stopped that.
Chris: There is a scale which rates the indecency of the content of images of children on a level 1 to 10. And these images definitely would meet the definition of level five just known as erotic posing.
Derek: They are Putting children in rather sensual positions for people who might be attracted to them.
NR: That is in normal camel clutch picture what we show them…(changes picture) We call that a grape vine.
Derek: A grape vine?
NR: That’s a normal grape vine.Unfortunately the angle is a little bit... but not every picture is like that.
Derek: You might call it the grapevine, but to many people out there, this is disturbing.
NR: I'm flabbergasted. Because that's a normal grape vine picture.
Derek: Late last year you deleted a number of your pictures from your website?
NR: Yes. Because I knew that people that see you like tying up stuff and stuff like that are offending people, and I removed that.
Derek: Weren't you being naive to think that this was alright?
NR: Maybe I was, but the thing, is It's just a story.

In February Carte Blanche discovered that Randall has created a new website.
NR: Unfortunately the server, the people that hosted fightingkids doesn't want fightingkids.
Derek: Now why didn't they want fightingkids?
NR: Because of the bad publicity they said, And I said I've been with you for 20 years.
Derek: So do you admit this was wrong?
NR: In hindsight I can see that It is a problem and I regret it. It’s just a story where the kids finally won, and ties the boy up and yah! See what happens? hopefully if it's God's will, we will we will. We will try and and and please the public outside.
Derek: Or please the right public?
NR: Please the right public. I will try my best. 12:09
